title: Past Simple and Past Continuous
description: Complete sentences describing interrupted actions and past events using the past simple or past continuous.

thumbnail.alt: An alarm clock ringing while someone is sleeping under a blanket

items.text: While I [[was studying]] in the library, my phone suddenly rang.
We [[were having]] dinner when the lights went out.
items.hint: Continuous background action in the past.

items.text: She [[was walking]] in the park when it started to snow.
items.hint: Ongoing action interrupted by a sudden event.

items.text: What [[were you doing]] when the loud noise occurred?
items.hint: Question about an activity in progress at a specific past moment.

items.text: He [[lost]] his keys while he was jogging around the lake.
items.hint: Short completed action that happened during an activity.

items.text: They were watching television while their father [[was cooking]] dinner.
items.hint: Two simultaneous actions in progress in the past.

items.text: I [[met]] an old friend while I was waiting for the subway.
items.hint: Sudden completed action interrupting a continuous one.

items.text: The students [[were listening]] attentively when the teacher announced the test.
items.hint: Continuous action in progress in the past.
